title: Farm Real Estate Loans Product Conversion Schedule
content:
A Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage may be moved from one FarmLand product to another without refinancing. Five terms govern this per product:

- **Conversion allowed** — whether the loan may be converted to another product without refinancing (yes or no).
- **Conversion targets** — the products the loan may be converted into.
- **Conversion fee percentage** — the conversion fee, as a percentage of the principal balance on the conversion date.
- **Minimum conversion fee** — in USD.
- **Spacing** — the calendar months that must pass after closing or the last conversion before a conversion.

## Conversion terms

| Converting from | Allowed | May be converted into | Fee (% of principal on conversion date) | Minimum fee (USD) | Spacing (calendar months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage | yes | FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage, FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage, FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage, FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage, FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | 0.25 | 500 | 6 |
| FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage | yes | FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage, FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage, FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage, FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage, FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | 0.25 | 500 | 12 |
| FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage | yes | FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage, FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage, FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage, FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage, FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | 0.25 | 500 | 12 |
| FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage | yes | FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage, FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage, FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage, FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage, FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | 0.375 | 750 | 12 |
| FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | yes | FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage, FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 0.5 | 1000 | 24 |
| FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | yes | FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage, FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 0.5 | 1000 | 24 |

## Points of reading

- The four shorter products may be converted into any other FarmLand product. The two fixed products have only two targets each: the 15-Year Fixed into the Variable-Rate or the 10-Year Adjustable, the 25-Year Fixed into the Variable-Rate or the 15-Year Fixed.
- The target list is read from the product the loan is in now, not from the product it would move to: a 25-Year Fixed loan may become a 15-Year Fixed loan, but the 15-Year Fixed list does not contain the 25-Year Fixed.

**Fee figures (hypothetical balances).** On a FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage with a principal balance of USD 400000 on the conversion date, 0.375 percent is USD 1500.00, above the USD 750 minimum. On a FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage with a balance of USD 150000, 0.25 percent is USD 375.00, below the minimum, so the fee is USD 500.00.
